cohort: 847 healthy women selected from the general population who delivered their first child between 1990 and 1997.
finding: Pelvic floor muscle trauma (PFMT), including levator avulsion and a levator hiatal area >40 cm2, is significantly associated with symptoms and signs of pelvic organ prolapse (sPOP and POP-Q ≥2) 20 years after a woman's first delivery.
